newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cenbank, govt agree to coordinate policy - CTK.
newsitem.headline: Czech cenbank, govt agree to coordinate policy - CTK.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) and the Czech government have agreed to coordinate their economic policies, the CTK news agency said quoting Finance Minister Ivan Kocarnik.

"There is agreement in that government measures and steps of the central bank must by coordinated, and that is key," it quoted Kocarnik as saying, explaining the results of a late night meeting on monetary policy between senior ministers and CNB Governor Josef Tosovosky.
The government has said it will introduce a package of measures aimed at addressing the budget and trade deficits and the overall macroeconomic situation on April 16.
Kocarnik, CTK said, warned however about jumping to conclusions about any change in monetary policy.

The Czech crown has lost more than a full percentage point from Wednesday's central bank fixing against its mark/dollar basket, as nervous crown traders await the results of the central bank's regular Thursday meeting.
The CNB fixed the crown on Thursday at 29.621 to the dollar after Wednesday's fixing at 29.447, and at 17.262 to the mark from 17.155.
The rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +1.20 percent, after a deviation of +1.80 on Wednesday.
The volatile interbank market pulled the crown another 60 basis points lower against the basket after the fixing.
